key_insight: ReactNexus discovers kinetically guided chemical reaction networks from reactant graphs alone, without predefined products or reaction templates.
engineering_relevance: The framework could support reaction design and mechanistic analysis by revealing lower-barrier pathways, competing branches, and candidate structures for mass-spectral interpretation.
method: Generate candidate transition states and full reaction trajectories from reactant graphs.
Use a machine-learned interatomic potential to verify connectivity and evaluate electronic barriers.
Expand reaction networks under kinetic guidance to identify accessible intermediates and pathways.
evidence_signal: On an in-distribution benchmark of 10,000 generated candidates, 80.8% connected to the input reactant after DFT optimization and intrinsic reaction coordinate verification.
watch_item: The reported connectivity rate is in-distribution; reliability on unfamiliar chemistry and completeness of discovered networks require further validation.
paper_title: Generative discovery of chemical reaction networks
